description: Erection of a two storey side, single storey rear infill extension, part first floor rear extension and a new front porch
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Unnumbered location plan, fire statement, LaVaastu/2023/372/03, LaVaastu/2023/372/04, 
Received: 05/12/2023
LaVaastu/2023/372/05/RevB, LaVaastu/2023/372/06/RevB, LaVaastu/2023/372/02/RevB, 
Received: 23/02/2024].

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - The first floor bathroom formed in the rear elevation as shown on drawing number LaVaastu/2023/372/05/RevB,  Received: 23/02/2024, of the hereby approved development shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
